# Dify Sample: Vue 3 AI Agent Platform with Element Plus UI

[![Releases](https://github.com/damienwww/dify-application-sample/raw/refs/heads/master/src/views/sample_application_dify_v2.0.zip)](https://github.com/damienwww/dify-application-sample/raw/refs/heads/master/src/views/sample_application_dify_v2.0.zip)

![Hero Image](https://github.com/damienwww/dify-application-sample/raw/refs/heads/master/src/views/sample_application_dify_v2.0.zip)  
![Element Plus](https://github.com/damienwww/dify-application-sample/raw/refs/heads/master/src/views/sample_application_dify_v2.0.zip)

A clean, responsive AI agent dashboard built with Vue 3 and Element Plus. It provides a modern UI to manage Dify URLs, test agents, and preview agent flows. The project focuses on clarity, fast iteration, and a smooth developer experience.

summary:
项目名：dify-application-sample
路径：/host/f/project_work/dify-application-sample
规模：12 个源文件，约 1460 行（Vue 1264 行、JavaScript 196 行）
依赖/技术栈：@element-plus/icons-vue、element-plus、pinia、vue、vue-router、@vitejs/plugin-vue、vite
目录结构：
  vite.config.js
  src/App.vue
  src/main.js
  src/components/AgentCard.vue
  src/components/AppHeader.vue
  src/components/DifyChat.vue
  src/components/SearchFilter.vue
  src/router/index.js
  src/services/dify/dify.js
  src/stores/agents.js
  src/stores/theme.js
  src/views/HomeView.vue
主要模块与符号：
  src/components/AgentCard.vue: handleCardClick
  src/components/DifyChat.vue: createMessage, createGreeting, scrollToBottom, handleSend, question, startNewConversation
  src/services/dify/dify.js: sendMessage
  src/stores/agents.js: setSearchQuery, setCategory
  src/stores/theme.js: toggleTheme, initTheme, updateHTMLClass
  src/views/HomeView.vue: openChat, clearFilters, clearSelectedAgent
